About

Jericho
Wilyan

I’m a communications and digital marketing professional with experience across premium automotive brands, regional campaigns, and motorsport-related activations.

Over the past few years, I’ve worked across digital communications, audience engagement, lifestyle campaigns, and premium brand storytelling — most notably during my time with Porsche Indonesia, where I helped shape content and experiences for one of the world’s most recognised automotive brands.

My experience also includes supporting the TAG Heuer Porsche Formula E Team during the Jakarta E-Prix across multiple seasons, contributing to communications and on-ground operations within a live international motorsport environment.

Currently, I work as Digital Marketing Specialist for the Asia Far East region at Militzer & Münch Indonesia, coordinating regional digital initiatives and multi-market communications across international markets in close collaboration with regional teams and headquarters.

My work focuses on social media strategy, brand storytelling, short-form content, and experiential communications — with a particular interest in how premium brands create emotional connection through atmosphere, culture, and audience engagement.

Social Media Strategy Brand Communications Content Planning Short-Form Content Analytics Event Activations Photography Regional Campaigns Premium Storytelling

Work

Porsche × Formula E
Jakarta E-Prix

Jakarta street circuit, with TAG Heuer Porsche Formula E Team competing during the Jakarta E-Prix.
Race week communications support, digital content coordination, and on-ground operations.
Audience-first storytelling shaped around the pace and atmosphere of race weekend.
Instagram, TikTok, press coverage, and live event communications.

Bridging the gap between Formula E's global media machine and Porsche Indonesia's local audience — translating the drama of race week into content that felt native, not imported.

Supported high-performing race week content across Porsche Indonesia’s social channels.

02 / 05

Porsche
Lifestyle Campaigns

Ongoing brand calendar activations connecting the Porsche world beyond the vehicle.
Content planning, digital campaigns, photography direction, and editorial storytelling.
Creating content that felt aspirational while remaining culturally grounded and visually consistent.
Instagram, email campaigns, editorial content, and retail activations.

Elevated Porsche Indonesia's content from product-forward posts to a living editorial archive — consistent in tone, aspirational in vision, always rooted in authentic Indonesian cultural context.

Supported consistent audience growth across Porsche Indonesia’s owned social channels.

03 / 05

Porsche × Urban
Sneakers Society

A collaboration between Porsche Indonesia and Urban Sneakers Society, connecting automotive heritage with Indonesia’s streetwear community.
Communications support, content production oversight, partnership storytelling, and digital amplification.
Balancing Porsche’s premium identity with a younger, culture-driven audience in a way that felt authentic to both worlds.
Social media, influencer collaborations, event content, and press coverage.

An unexpected pairing executed with precision — establishing Porsche as a cultural participant rather than a legacy observer, and opening the brand to an entirely new Indonesian audience segment.

Supported digital amplification for one of Porsche Indonesia’s key lifestyle collaborations.

Coordinating multi-market campaigns, regional content strategy, and digital communications initiatives.
Applying a more editorial and audience-focused approach to an industry often dominated by technical communication.
LinkedIn, regional websites, newsletters, and internal communications.

Applying editorial rigour and premium brand language to a complex, multi-stakeholder logistics environment — bringing the same discipline that defined Porsche communications to a new industry.

Supporting regional brand consistency across multiple Asia Far East markets.
